narrator.how: calm, dry and clear, a little amused and a little sad, unhurried — like a Tove Jansson book read aloud on a grey summer morning
narrator.name: narrator

grandma.how: an old woman, dry and short, as of a matter of business; mocking, never soft, never sorry for herself; tired underneath
grandma.name: Grandmother

grandma_song.how: an old woman singing an old song of the skerries under her breath, hoarse and slow, a lullaby tune, losing the words and humming over the gaps
grandma_song.name: Grandmother, singing

sophia.how: a girl of six: quick, bossy and loud, stamps her foot, swears and orders; when it matters, suddenly serious as a grown-up and very quiet
sophia.name: Sophia

sophia_song.how: a girl of six singing to herself without words, a made-up tune, high and thin, solemn, a little out of tune
sophia_song.name: Sophia, singing

papa.how: a quiet man who lost his wife this spring: level and short, only about things to be done, without lifting his eyes; when moved, he breaks off
papa.name: Papa

eriksson.how: an old fisherman from the far skerries: hoarse, slow, plain, without pity; a few words and no goodbye
eriksson.name: Eriksson
